leadText:
Lacy (Japanese: レイシ Reishi) is a character of the day who appeared in The Problem with Paras. She is Cassandra's grandmother.

The grandmother was first seen grinding herbs at the herbal shop. When and requested to buy some Potions and Antidotes, she offered them snake root ( whiskers in the Japanese version) that cures insomnia and grow hair on the nose and tongue. She was then scolded by her granddaughter, Cassandra. She told Ash that in order to control , he had to gain its respect by earning more Badges. She was last seen having found a to be the company mascot, after Cassandra rejected .
